s1.desc: a snowy landscape of rolling hills with snow-capped pine trees under a pale sky

s2.desc: a snowy clearing beside a frozen lake, with pine trees under dark grey storm clouds

spans.notes: two pieces, both under 21 frames: static f0-8 (9 frames, ECC on the left tree band scale 1.0000, 0 px) as Pax lifts a picnic basket out of a red snowmobile, then a pan to the right f9-26 (background tx -11, -35, -64, -100 px at f9-12) revealing Polly; locked from f27 (ECC vs f27: 0 px, cc 1.000).

spans.view: with a snow-capped pine tree behind them

beats.text: Pax holds a picnic basket and glances sideways at Polly, who stands beside him with a doubtful frown
Pax looks ahead and opens and closes his beak as he speaks while Polly keeps frowning beside him
Pax tilts his brows into a worried frown while Polly stares ahead with a flat frown

spans.notes: camera locked f27-49 (ECC on the tree/hill band 0.12-0.36 vs f27: scale 1.0000, 0 px, cc 1.000; compare 27/49 background edges all black). The snowmobile's nose is cut off at the left edge. No overlay.

spans.view: with a red snowmobile parked in the snow in the foreground

beats.text: Pax and Polly stand side by side with their backs turned, gazing out over the frozen lake, Pax holding a picnic basket
Pax and Polly turn their heads toward each other and trade blank, glum looks

spans.notes: camera locked f50-81: ECC on the lake/tree band left (0.58-0.75, x 0-0.3) scale 1.0000, 0 px; right tree <1 px; compare 50/81 trees, lake and snowmobile edges black. Only the storm clouds drift (they are animated). Both leads seen from behind. No overlay.

Walmart ad section, one run: f82-123 Pax and Polly with Walmart-logo shopping bags in front of an igloo store with a Walmart sign (a golden light-ray glow washes in from the left from ~f97, also an effect); cut at f124 to Pax with the logo bags (f124-141); wipe transition f142-143; f144-157 Polly with a logo bag under the Walmart sign; cut at f158 to a sunset over sand dunes, Pax and Polly from behind among parked cars setting down the logo bags (spark logo legible at full res on every frame f158-202), Polly holding up a red can from ~f180.
